policy: An authority tier says who issued a source, not whether a particular statement in it is true. Only the four primary tiers may discharge Level 2 on their own, and never for a fact class a bound discipline profile marks as requiring independent corroboration. A foreign national guideline is admitted as a peer-reviewed guideline rather than a primary authority, because this bank examines Canadian practice and a single foreign guideline does not settle a Canadian critical value on its own. A tertiary fallback discharges nothing.
